title: Correct B magnitude
description: Essential: The answer for part (1) must be B = 2 m v_0 / (q d).

title: Correct total time
description: Essential: The answer for part (2) must be t = (11π + 3√3) d / (3 v_0).

title: Correct circular field B
description: Essential: The answer for part (3) must be B_circular = 6 m v_0 / (5 q d).

title: Lorentz force centripetal relation
description: Important: Student must apply qvB = m v^2 / r to relate magnetic field to trajectory radius.

title: Geometry for trajectory radii
description: Important: Student must correctly deduce the radii (e.g., d/2, 5d/6, 2d) from the equilateral triangle geometry and given angles.

title: Time from arc motion
description: Important: Student must calculate times in magnetic fields using t = (θ/2π) * T, where T is the period of circular motion.

title: Time in straight segment
description: Optional: Student calculates the time for the straight-line segment DP using t = distance / v_0.

title: Field direction sign error
description: Pitfall: Student confuses the direction (inward/outward) of the magnetic fields when applying the right-hand rule, leading to incorrect force direction or radius sign.

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Student misinterprets the 60° or 120° deflection angles, leading to incorrect central angles for arc motion.
